line-endings           on   fix  Use one line ending throughout.
rem-comments           off  fix  Write Rem comments with an apostrophe.
comment-space          off  fix  Put a space after the apostrophe of a comment.
let-keyword            off  fix  Drop the optional Let from assignments.
keyword-case           on   fix  Spell keywords the way the VBE does.
identifier-case        on   fix  Spell names the way they are declared.
numeric-literals       on   fix  Spell numbers the way the VBE does.
date-literals          on   fix  Spell dates the way the VBE does.
statement-form         on   fix  Write Call Foo() and Else x the way the VBE does.
split-statements       off  fix  Put each statement on a line of its own.
spacing                on   fix  Space tokens the way the VBE writes them.
indent                 on   fix  Indent lines by block structure.
continuation-indent    on   fix  Indent continuation lines consistently.
align-declarations     off  fix  Align As in runs of declarations.
trailing-comments      on   fix  Place end-of-line comments consistently.
trailing-whitespace    on   fix  Remove whitespace at the end of lines.
blank-lines            on   fix  Keep blank lines consistent.
end-of-file            on   fix  End the file with one line break.
max-line-length        off       Report lines longer than a limit.
suppression-directive  on        Report suppression directives that cannot be read.
